sourceReuse.direction: User-authorized code-led source reuse; no seed or comp claim
sourceReuse.layout: 244px task sidebar (210px compact); 44px main toolbar; 68px chat header; independently scrolling conversation with fixed action dock; default-open resizable file/diff/session inspector
sourceReuse.composer: Codex shipped CSS, React state adapter
sourceReuse.plan: Vibe ChatEntryContainer and ChatTodoList inside the conversation; border/background/muted theme mapping
sourceReuse.timeline: T3 ChatView composition, UserTimelineRow container and TimelineSystemDivider adapted to Rondo task/jobs
sourceReuse.recordModel: Full saved WorkBuddy report initially expanded; native events and bounded historical metadata are not complete event sourcing or full native chat history.
workspaceAdaptations: ChatView parent composition extracted to React slots; existing Rondo jobs replace T3 state/transport
UserTimelineRow message container extracted; attachments and guest accounts omitted because Rondo does not provide them
TimelineSystemDivider copied; import aliases and Base UI Tooltip render prop adapted to installed Radix asChild
Right panel tab pattern adapted to existing react-resizable-panels; no upstream browser/terminal services copied

rolePicker.kind: ordinary extension of Jean Field/Button with native selects
rolePicker.behavior: planner/executor/reviewer labels; role-filtered options, unavailable adapters disabled; read-only installation detection and refresh; Manage Agent opens settings while preserving task draft; removed task choices visibly disabled; task-bound selected Agent names
rolePicker.limits: Installation discovery is not login verification, model execution, or certification of commercial ACP account combinations.

agentSetup.kind: ordinary source-led extension; preserves the Jean/T3/Vibe/Codex/Pierre visual world and existing tokens

sources.reuse: AgentCard row; availability filters; LocalAgents search/filter and custom create/edit/save/refresh flow; InlineAgentEditor separate executable/argv fields
AcpReadinessPanel status, diagnostics and action structure; SettingsView inspected for workspace allocation, not runtime reuse

agentSetup.layout: Task sidebar retained; 272px directory and flexible detail, 220px directory at <=1100px; list and detail scroll independently; fixed bottom Add action; inline editor max-width 640px
agentSetup.interaction: Native executable file picker; separate ordered argv inputs; saved identifier fixed; returning preserves task draft and compact three-role selects
agentSetup.conflictRecovery: Retain pending identifier/program/argv, load latest config revision, then require explicit Save configuration retry; no automatic submit
agentSetup.protocolTruth: Explicit initialize-only handshake; no prompt, development session, authentication or model call; installation, protocol readiness and account availability remain separate facts

evidence.reviewScope: Initial finish review identified one conflict-action issue; its fix was reviewed as resolved with disposition ship, alongside original matching evidence. This does not certify all commercial Agent backends.
evidence.documentPass: Static source and nine existing capture review only; no model calls, UI runs or implementation tests rerun.

agentSetup.limits: No upstream authentication/analytics/backend runtime copied; trusted local single-user Windows source build; no cross-platform packaged installation or universal commercial-account acceptance claim.

narrative.northStar: 可操作的 Agent 会话工作台
narrative.overview:
Rondo 直接复用成熟 Agent 产品的可用源码结构，以任务侧栏、会话列和产物面板组织工作。Jean 的中性浅深主题与 Windows 字体保持不变；本轮更换空间结构，不新增品牌配色、装饰图片或自行编造的视觉世界。

主工作区采用 T3 Code 的 ChatView 组合、用户消息容器、TimelineSystemDivider 与右侧面板模式；Rondo 的持久任务、规划、执行与审查替代上游状态及传输。精确来源与必要适配见 `vendor/t3code/workspace-provenance.json`，不把抽出的组合容器称作完整移植 T3 运行时。需求与真实 Agent 返回连续可读，当前动作固定在会话底部，文件、改动和已保存原生会话默认在右侧可达。
keyCharacteristics: 中性浅深工作面与紧凑任务导航。
可滚动消息流、固定动作区与独立产物面板。
复用实际组件，显示真实任务、完整提交及可解释状态。

rules.name: The Semantic Theme Rule
rules.body: 页面及复用控件使用语义变量；切换主题时共同变化，不在单个控件中另造浅深配色。

dos: **Do** 优先复用已移植组件、语义主题与现有交互。
**Do** 将完整需求、Agent 返回、产物与当前动作留在同一任务上下文。
**Do** 保留消息、源码、差异和列表各自的滚动边界及键盘焦点。
**Do** 区分真实状态、已保存记录、只读刷新与消耗额度的动作。
donts: **Don't** 恢复旧图标轨、墨绿静态角色栏或默认收起完整执行报告的旧布局。
**Don't** 为填满页面虚构任务、报告、进度、会话或连接成功。
**Don't** 将源码结构复用说成完整移植上游运行时，或将窗口截图扩大为原生会话与审批验收。
